annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于取消和下放一批行政许可事项的决定
annotation.title_en: Decision of the State Council on Cancelling and Delegating a Batch of Administrative Licensing Items
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council decision of 13 September 2020 cancelling 29 administrative licensing items and delegating approval of 4 others, with post-approval supervision measures for each. It has no AI or robotics content; only a passing item on non-commercial general aviation registration becoming filing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cancels 29 administrative licences; many replaced by filing/registration
Delegates approval level of 4 licences to lower authorities
Requires departments to publish post-approval supervision rules within 20 working days
Strengthens 'double random, one open' inspections and credit supervision
Non-commercial general aviation approval changed to filing, with airworthiness and flight monitoring
